Overview¶

Roles¶

  • Reader - can only view articles and newsletters, and subscribe to publishers and journalists.

  • Journalist - can create, view, update and delete articles and newsletters (their own).

  • Editor - can view, update, delete and approve articles and newsletters, and create and manage publishers.

Approval workflow¶

Articles start unapproved. When an editor approves one, a post_save signal (news.signals) e-mails the subscribers of its journalist or publisher and POSTs the article to the project’s own /api/approved/ endpoint. See news.services for the side effects.

REST API¶

Authenticate with POST /api/token/ and send the returned token as Authorization: Token <token>. Journalists can create articles, editors can approve them, and readers can only view. The views are in news.api_views.
